content.text:
I submitted **index 19 (Cr 0.378 / Sb 0.622)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.029%, the highest of the three I measured, but it's only a little above the next one.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.285 | 0.016 |
| 14 | 0.49 (about CrSbO4) | 0.027 |
| 19 | 0.622 | 0.029 |

- **Why these three:** The model predicted that CrSbO4 has a band gap of about 1.98 eV, small enough to absorb the 2.1 eV light, so I started at the 1:1 composition. Then I tested the Cr-rich side. EQE was lower there, so I spent the last measurement on the Sb-rich side. The model predicts a much smaller band gap there (about 0.88 eV for Cr3Sb5O16), so those films should absorb more light.
- **What's still uncertain:** EQE was still rising slowly at the last point, so compositions richer in Sb (indices 20–28) could be better, but none of them were measured. With only three measurements, the true best in the library could also lie between the points I tested.
- **Not used:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so no crystal phase was confirmed in any film.
